aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Return Order Net Impact
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  order_status,
  COUNT(*) AS return_orders,
  SUM(sale_settled_amount) AS gross_return_value_reversed,
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax) AS return_logistics_excl_gst,
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_gst) AS return_logistics_gst,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settlement_impact,
  ROUND(SUM(settled_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS avg_net_impact_per_return
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND order_status IN ('Return', 'RTO')
GROUP BY order_status;
